audited_source_corrections.action: Supplied the missing noun ‘definition’ in the section's statement of purpose.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says ‘offer a transfinite by (transfinite) recursion,’ leaving the direct object incomplete; the surrounding sentences concern definitions and the success of the displayed V-alpha definition.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாக்கியம் ‘முடிவிலிக்கடந்த மீள்வரையறையால் எந்த முடிவிலிக்கடந்த வரையறையை வழங்கும் முயற்சியும்’ என்று விடுபட்ட ‘வரையறை’ பொருளை வெளிப்படையாக வழங்குகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Preserving the ungrammatical ellipsis; treating ‘transfinite’ as an otherwise undefined noun.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding and following sentences explicitly identify the object under discussion as a definition, and the section proves recursion principles that legitimate such definitions.
